summary: Strategy Inc filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) to report shareholder approval at its 2026 Annual Meeting to amend the terms of its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock (STRC) by changing dividend record and payment dates from monthly to semi-monthly. No deal terms, price, premium, or advisors are involved. This is a routine governance and capital structure maintenance event equivalent to a U.S. 8-K for other events. No special-situation trigger exists; the filing merely reflects a shareholder-approved amendment to dividend timing.
